title: Si-clauses in the Story of Monterrey

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *si* + present from B1 Unit 8 for a realistic condition (*Si perdemos el tren, tomaremos el siguiente*). And you know *Si yo fuera tú* and *si tuviera más tiempo* from B1 Unit 4: *si* + imperfect subjunctive, with the conditional in the result, for an imagined situation. Both are useful for Monterrey, a city whose future depends on water: what happens if it rains less, and what would happen if the city could reuse more.

sections.title: Two kinds of condition
rows: A real possibility: Si llueve menos, habrá menos agua. (If it rains less, there will be less water.)
An imagined situation: Si la ciudad reutilizara más agua, la presión sería menor. (If the city reused more water, the pressure would be less.)
Not Si la ciudad reutilizaría más agua, but Si reutilizara. The conditional goes in the result.

sections.title: Forms to keep in mind
sections.content: The imperfect subjunctive comes from the *ellos* form of the *indefinido*: *hubieron* gives *hubiera* (or *hubiese*), *pudieron* gives *pudiera*, *tuvieron* gives *tuviera*. *Hubiera* is the form of *haber* for "there were": *Si hubiera más lluvia, el problema sería menor*.

items.spanish: Si llueve menos, la ciudad tendrá menos agua.
items.english: If it rains less, the city will have less water.

items.spanish: Si hubiera más lluvia, el problema del agua sería menor.
items.english: If there were more rain, the water problem would be smaller.

items.spanish: Si Monterrey pudiera reutilizar más agua, la presión sería menor.
items.english: If Monterrey could reuse more water, the pressure would be less.

items.spanish: Si no hubiera agua suficiente, la industria tendría problemas.
items.english: If there were not enough water, industry would have problems.

items.spanish: Si la población sigue creciendo, el consumo de agua aumentará.
items.english: If the population keeps growing, water use will increase.

sections.content: Choose by how you see the situation: if it is a real possibility, *si* + present; if you are imagining something that is not true now, *si* + imperfect subjunctive.
